package.name: stm32_bridge
package.description: OmniNav serial bridge: a ROS2 Jazzy node linking STM32F103 (USART2, 115200 8N1) to the Raspberry Pi 5. Subscribes to /cmd_vel and sends V frames; parses E/B/A frames and publishes /odom, TF odom->base_link, /battery_state and /diagnostics. Mecanum forward/inverse kinematics and arc-integration odometry are **not** in this package; they are always called via ctypes into libomninav_core.so built from firmware_core (contract §3/§5).
